Thank you for your interest in Sacramento State!


This articulation agreement displays the lower-division courses required in the major: Sacramento State courses on the left and approved (articulated) transfer courses on the right. Although completion of the coursework listed below is not mandatory prior to admission, students are advised to complete as much lower-division course preparation as possible prior to transfer.


Additional Resources:

  • See the University Catalog for the full listing of degree requirements for this major.
  • Visit our Sac State Apply page for more information about our campus!

  1. Students must earn a \"C-\" grade or higher in all courses required in the major.
  2. The Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) in Communication Studies is compatible with the B.A. in Public Relations at Sacramento State. Students pursuing the Associate Degree for Transfer must complete all lower-division major coursework with a \"C\" or better.
  3. Prior to acceptance as a Public Relations major, students must complete a pre-major consisting of all required lower-division courses plus the upper-division survey course (COMS 100A) and upper-division research methodology course (COMS 100C). COMS 100A and COMS 100C must be taken at Sacramento State.
  4. All Communication Studies majors are required to complete at least one 3 unit public speaking course such as COMS 4 or a transfer equivalent. Public speaking courses taken to fulfill the CSU GE Area 1C Oral Communication requirement also fulfill this Department requirement.
  5. Communication Studies courses may only be repeated once for a grade change. Students who fail to achieve at least a \"C-\" in two attempts in a core course will be disqualified in majoring in Public Relations.
  6. The department also offers a degree in Communication Studies. See the \"Communication Studies, BA\" for additional information.
  7. For additional information, please visit: Department of Communication Studies.
